name: Torrijas (Spain)
description: Blue field with red stripes with a yellow embattled inner edge along the upper and lower edges, charged at the hoist with a yellow tower.
history: Municipal flag of Torrijas; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: stripe with an embattled yellow inner edge along the upper edge
stripe with an embattled yellow inner edge along the lower edge
